text: Testing playbook: Enumerate request parameters from proxy history and OpenAPI or GraphQL introspection, then build a contract for each field and test values outside that contract. Use differential requests that hold all other fields constant so the effect of a single mutation is attributable. Read the persisted record rather than trusting the response body, because many systems echo the submitted value while normalizing it differently in storage. Target phases: Parameter and schema inventory; Contract reconstruction; Out-of-contract mutation; Persistence verification. Tools: Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Python requests, JSON Schema.

metadata.title: CWE-20 Testing Methodology: Contract Reconstruction and Mutation

text: Testing playbook: Trace data from user-controlled fields into exports, webhooks, queues, and batch jobs. Submit grammar characters appropriate to each consumer rather than a generic XSS or SQLi list, and verify by reading the consumer's own artifacts. Where the consumer is unavailable, use a local replica of its parser to prove that record boundaries change. Target phases: Data-flow tracing; Consumer grammar identification; Delimiter injection; Downstream artifact inspection. Tools: Burp Suite, Python csv module, Custom parser replicas, Log analysis.

metadata.title: CWE-74 Testing Methodology: Downstream Grammar Injection

text: Testing playbook: Locate shell-outs through source review, timing differences, and file artifacts. Fuzz with the grammar of the actual interpreter (shell, ImageMagick, ffmpeg, git) rather than a generic payload list, and include leading-dash operands. Use a controlled sandbox to observe the resulting process tree and file writes without affecting production data. Target phases: Shell-out discovery; Interpreter grammar mapping; Metacharacter and argument fuzzing; Privilege and data-scope confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, Process Monitor, strace or Procmon, Custom payload generator.

metadata.title: CWE-77 Testing Methodology: Interpreter-Aware Command Fuzzing

text: Testing playbook: Map expression surfaces including rule builders, calculated fields, email templates, and export formulas. Use canary variables from a second account and probe for reflection of object properties. Test time and resource limits as well, because unbounded evaluation is itself a business-denial condition. Target phases: Expression surface inventory; Symbol and scope probing; Cross-tenant evaluation; Persistence and execution confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, Expression payload corpus, Second test tenant, Timing analysis.

metadata.title: CWE-94 Testing Methodology: Expression Surface and Symbol Probing

text: Testing playbook: Intercept outbound messages at the application boundary and compare the raw wire format with the receiver's parsed representation. Test quotes, backslashes, CRLF, and entity sequences in each field. Where messages are signed, verify whether the signature covers the injected portion. Target phases: Outbound message inventory; Wire-format inspection; Encoding bypass testing; Receiver-side action confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, Webhook receiver, JSON and XML parsers, Mail trap.

metadata.title: CWE-116 Testing Methodology: Wire-Format and Receiver-Parser Comparison

text: Testing playbook: Use structured fuzzing against import, preview, and conversion endpoints with length fields mutated around buffer boundaries. Compare response sizes and content for anomalies and run the target under an instrumentation build where available. Treat any response byte that was not submitted as a disclosure finding. Target phases: Parser surface inventory; Length and offset mutation; Response byte attribution; Cross-scope data confirmation. Tools: AFL++, Burp Suite Intruder, Python struct, AddressSanitizer.

metadata.title: CWE-125 Testing Methodology: Boundary Mutation of Length and Offset Fields

text: Testing playbook: Enumerate indexed parameters in JSON bodies, form arrays, and GraphQL list arguments. Mutate indices across boundaries and across two accounts to detect cross-owner selection. Capture the server's resolution order by varying collection size, then verify with a second account whether the mutation landed on the wrong record. Target phases: Indexed parameter inventory; Bounds and sign fuzzing; Cross-owner resolution testing; Persisted element confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, Two test accounts, Python requests, Differential state checks.

metadata.title: CWE-129 Testing Methodology: Index Boundary and Cross-Owner Probing

text: Testing playbook: Compare declared allocation with observed artifact size across many input shapes. Use boundary values around multiplication overflow points and variable-length fields with multi-byte characters. Verify completeness by comparing a checksum or record count between source and export. Target phases: Bulk path inventory; Size computation analysis; Boundary and expansion input testing; Export integrity verification. Tools: Burp Suite, Python size model, Checksum comparison, Memory sanitizers.

metadata.title: CWE-131 Testing Methodology: Allocation Versus Artifact Size Comparison

text: Testing playbook: Submit format specifiers into every field that appears in logs or generated documents, then compare output length and content with a control request. Use positional and width specifiers to map the stack layout. Confirm disclosure by matching leaked values against known session or tenant identifiers. Target phases: Format sink inventory; Specifier probing; Disclosure mapping; Write-capability assessment. Tools: Burp Suite, Log viewer, gdb, Canary values.

metadata.title: CWE-134 Testing Methodology: Specifier Probing of Log-Bound Fields

text: Testing playbook: For each identifier, send upper-case, lower-case, and mixed-case variants to both the enforcement endpoint and the data endpoint. Compare status codes and persisted effects. Pay attention to email, role names, coupon codes, and URL paths where proxies and application servers may differ. Target phases: Cross-layer identifier inventory; Case-variant matrix; Enforcement versus lookup comparison; Privileged-record confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, Case mutation wordlist, Second account, Unicode normalization tools.

metadata.title: CWE-178 Testing Methodology: Case-Variant Authorization Matrix

text: Testing playbook: Map decode and normalize steps by submitting layered encodings and observing which layer responds. Compare the allow-list decision with the final destination or resolved path. Use a proxy to inspect the value at each hop, and test double decoding explicitly. Target phases: Normalization mapping; Layered encoding tests; Check-versus-sink comparison; Restricted resource confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, Encoding utilities, Proxy history, Custom decoders.

metadata.title: CWE-180 Testing Methodology: Layered Encoding and Normalization Mapping

text: Testing playbook: Treat the allow-list as a hypothesis and test its edges: case, suffixes, encodings, and derived types. For file uploads, test content-type confusion and same-origin rendering. For hosts and redirects, test prefix and wildcard matches. Verify impact in the context where the value is consumed, not at upload time. Target phases: Allow-list extraction; Edge-value testing; Capability analysis in trusted context; Impact confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, File-type corpus, DNS and host test domains, Browser devtools.

metadata.title: CWE-183 Testing Methodology: Allow-List Edge and Capability Testing

text: Testing playbook: Collect deny-list behavior from responses, then test equivalent forms systematically: case, Unicode, encoding layers, duplicate parameters, and alternate endpoints. Prefer testing the business outcome directly over the blocked string, because the outcome is what the control is supposed to prevent. Target phases: Deny-list behavior mapping; Equivalent-form generation; Alternate-route discovery; Business-outcome verification. Tools: Burp Suite, Unicode payload corpus, GraphQL introspection, Param miner.

metadata.title: CWE-184 Testing Methodology: Equivalent-Form and Alternate-Route Probing

text: Testing playbook: Model each arithmetic path and test the zero and one-unit boundaries, especially refunds and reversals. Use concurrent requests to combine with race conditions where the check and debit are separate. Verify by reading the persisted balance and ledger, not the response. Target phases: Arithmetic path inventory; Zero and boundary manipulation; Refund and reversal abuse; Ledger persistence verification. Tools: Burp Suite, Turbo Intruder, Python decimal model, Database read access.

metadata.title: CWE-191 Testing Methodology: Zero-Boundary and Reversal Arithmetic

text: Testing playbook: For each limit, submit exactly N, N+1, and N-1 operations and read the persisted count. Combine with duplicate parameters and parallel requests. Test limits that count distinct rows versus total quantity, because the two definitions often disagree at the boundary. Target phases: Limit inventory; Boundary submission; Duplicate and concurrency testing; Persisted count verification. Tools: Burp Suite Intruder, Turbo Intruder, Python requests, Database checks.

metadata.title: CWE-193 Testing Methodology: N, N+1 Boundary Testing

text: Testing playbook: Build a table of type boundaries and fractional values, then submit each amount through the full payment flow. Compare the authorization, the stored record, and the settlement report. Include currency conversion paths where two rounding steps can compound. Target phases: Precision boundary mapping; Boundary and fractional submission; Authorization-versus-settlement comparison; Monetary impact confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, Python decimal, Payment sandbox, Ledger exports.

metadata.title: CWE-197 Testing Methodology: Precision Boundary and Settlement Comparison

text: Testing playbook: Build a three-way comparison harness for valid, invalid, and nonexistent inputs. Normalize dynamic content and measure timing over many samples. Use the harness on coupon, invitation, invoice, and account-recovery endpoints, which are the highest-value enumeration surfaces. Target phases: Response baseline capture; Three-way differential analysis; Rate-safe enumeration; Follow-on abuse validation. Tools: Burp Suite Comparer, ffuf, Python requests, Timing harness.

metadata.title: CWE-204 Testing Methodology: Three-Way Response Differential

text: Testing playbook: Submit malformed, empty, wrong, and boundary values to every workflow step and capture full responses including headers. Search responses for patterns matching tokens, codes, and internal host names. Then test whether the disclosed value satisfies the next step, which converts a low-severity disclosure into a workflow bypass. Target phases: Error-path enumeration; Response content mining; Secret correlation; Workflow completion test. Tools: Burp Suite, grep and regex extraction, Response diffing, Log review.

metadata.title: CWE-209 Testing Methodology: Error-Path Content Mining

text: Testing playbook: Request every export and report available to a low-privilege role and inspect it for password-like fields. Review logging configuration for credential capture. Where a test account exists, attempt recovery and authentication, and verify that the resulting access exceeds the original role. Target phases: Reachable store inventory; Storage format analysis; Recovery attempt on test account; Privilege confirmation. Tools: Database client, Log analysis, hashid, Test accounts.

metadata.title: CWE-256 Testing Methodology: Store, Export, and Log Recovery Testing

text: Testing playbook: Search public images, repositories, and client binaries for password patterns and default account names. Use secret-scanning rules and manual review of configuration. Validate each candidate against the corresponding interface from an external network position. Target phases: Artifact collection; Secret scanning; Credential validation; Privilege and business-action confirmation. Tools: trufflehog, gitleaks, docker, Burp Suite.

metadata.title: CWE-259 Testing Methodology: Artifact Secret Scanning and Validation

text: Testing playbook: Create principals through every available path and read back the effective permissions. Test invitation, self-registration, trial conversion, and subscription downgrade. Compare what the UI claims with what the API permits, then exercise each permission to confirm real access. Target phases: Role assignment path inventory; Effective-permission readback; Downgrade and revocation testing; Restricted-function exercise. Tools: Burp Suite, Two accounts with different roles, Admin console, Permission matrix.

metadata.title: CWE-266 Testing Methodology: Assignment-Path Permission Readback

text: Testing playbook: Review IAM policies, service accounts, and container security contexts for wildcards and root. Map reachable roles from the application's trust boundaries. Test with a controlled exploit or debug endpoint to confirm whether the service credentials reach an unrelated resource. Target phases: Identity and permission inventory; Reachability analysis; Credential acquisition test; Lateral resource access. Tools: Cloud IAM analyzers, ScoutSuite, Container inspection, Burp Suite.

metadata.title: CWE-272 Testing Methodology: Service Identity Reachability Analysis

text: Testing playbook: Collect requests containing user, account, tenant, or owner identifiers and swap them between two test accounts. Test unauthenticated access to the same routes and optional steps. Confirm by reading the victim account's state, not by trusting the response. Target phases: Identity parameter inventory; Cross-account substitution; Unauthenticated route testing; Victim-state confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, Two test accounts, Autorize, Session analysis.

metadata.title: CWE-287 Testing Methodology: Cross-Account Identity Substitution

text: Testing playbook: Diff route inventories from the web app, mobile client, OpenAPI documents, and JavaScript bundles. Test each discovered handler with no session, an expired session, and a low-privilege session. Include websockets and internal-looking endpoints that the gateway may not protect. Target phases: Channel and route inventory; Handler duplication mapping; Weak-credential access testing; Business-function execution. Tools: Burp Suite, Mobile proxy, OpenAPI diffing, LinkFinder.

metadata.title: CWE-288 Testing Methodology: Cross-Channel Route Enumeration

text: Testing playbook: Map functions restricted by network origin and attempt them from outside the range with manipulated forwarding headers and address encodings. Look for SSRF primitives that can originate requests inside the trusted network. Confirm the business action, not merely the response code. Target phases: Address-restricted surface inventory; Header and encoding manipulation; SSRF pivot testing; Privileged action confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, SSRF test harness, IPv6 encoding tools, Internal proxy.

metadata.title: CWE-291 Testing Methodology: Address Manipulation and SSRF Pivot

text: Testing playbook: Enumerate cookies, hidden fields, local storage, and token claims used by the authentication flow. Mutate each one independently and replay the request. Include deletion and type changes, because absent optional fields frequently default to the privileged state. Target phases: Client-state inventory; Value mutation and deletion; Server-decision observation; Protected-area access. Tools: Burp Suite, Browser devtools, JWT editor, Cookie manager.

metadata.title: CWE-302 Testing Methodology: Client-State Mutation and Deletion

text: Testing playbook: Instrument the flow to find the exact point where the session becomes usable. Replay later requests before completing verification and with fields omitted. Compare the server's state with the UI's state, since the UI frequently enforces steps the API does not. Target phases: Flow instrumentation; Pre-verification session testing; Field omission; Protected-endpoint access. Tools: Burp Suite, Browser devtools, Python requests, Session timeline.

metadata.title: CWE-304 Testing Methodology: Session Validity Point Analysis

text: Testing playbook: Crawl and fuzz for routes not present in the UI, then replay them with no cookies or tokens. Pay particular attention to webhook, callback, export, and maintenance paths. Verify impact by reading the affected business record rather than the response message. Target phases: Unauthenticated route discovery; Critical-function classification; Minimal-body invocation; Business-state confirmation. Tools: ffuf, Burp Suite, Wayback Machine, JS bundle analysis.

metadata.title: CWE-306 Testing Methodology: Unauthenticated Route and Callback Testing

text: Testing playbook: Proxy the full flow and inspect every request for scheme and secret placement. Check mobile and internal integrations separately. Use a network capture on a test segment to confirm plaintext, and attempt replay of any captured token. Target phases: Channel inventory; Scheme and secret-placement review; Network observation; Token replay confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, Wireshark, SSL Labs, Log inspection.

metadata.title: CWE-319 Testing Methodology: Channel and Secret-Placement Review

text: Testing playbook: Scan source, images, and mobile packages for key material and algorithm identifiers. Reconstruct the signing or encryption scheme, then forge a message against a test endpoint. Confirm by observing the business effect rather than a generic success response. Target phases: Key material discovery; Scheme reconstruction; Forgery and submission; Business-effect confirmation. Tools: trufflehog, CyberChef, Python cryptography, Burp Suite.

metadata.title: CWE-321 Testing Methodology: Key Extraction and Message Forgery

text: Testing playbook: Collect hashes from tokens, exports, and stored values and identify the algorithm. Test whether the input is predictable, then attempt offline cracking with a representative wordlist. For integrity checks, test collision and length-extension behavior where the construction allows it. Target phases: Hash identification; Input predictability analysis; Cracking or collision attempt; Security-decision bypass. Tools: hashid, hashcat, CyberChef, Python hashlib.

metadata.title: CWE-328 Testing Methodology: Hash Identification and Reproduction

text: Testing playbook: Collect identifiers across accounts and time, then test for arithmetic progression, timestamp correlation, and reuse. Generate predicted values and probe with rate-limited requests. Bind each finding to a cross-account access attempt before reporting. Target phases: Identifier sampling; Pattern inference; Prediction and probing; Cross-account access confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite Intruder, Python analysis, Custom generators, Rate-limited fuzzing.

metadata.title: CWE-340 Testing Methodology: Identifier Pattern Inference

text: Testing playbook: Use a desync-aware testing tool against a staging replica of the production chain. Send CL.TE and TE.CL probes and measure response timing and connection reuse. Confirm smuggled actions by observing the backend's own records, not the front-end response. Target phases: Edge stack fingerprinting; Framing ambiguity probing; Hop parsing analysis; Smuggled action confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite HTTP Request Smuggler, Turbo Intruder, h2c probes, Timing analysis.

metadata.title: CWE-444 Testing Methodology: Desync Probing and Hop Analysis

text: Testing playbook: Test the registration and reset endpoints with boundary lengths, common passwords, and entries from a breach corpus. Measure lockout and rate limiting on login. Then evaluate whether a guessed credential reaches a function with monetary or data impact. Target phases: Policy boundary testing; Breached-password acceptance; Rate-limit assessment; Privileged-function impact. Tools: Burp Suite Intruder, SecLists, HIBP corpus, Rate-limit harness.

metadata.title: CWE-521 Testing Methodology: Policy Boundary and Guessing Resistance

text: Testing playbook: Collect every redirect parameter from login, logout, OAuth, payment, and share flows. Test external targets using multiple encoding forms and look-alike hosts. Confirm by observing the Location header and the final browser origin, not by reading the parameter. Target phases: Redirect parameter inventory; External target testing; Allow-list bypass; Final-origin confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, Browser devtools, URL encoder, Look-alike domain lab.

metadata.title: CWE-601 Testing Methodology: Redirect Parameter and Allow-List Bypass

text: Testing playbook: Trace where approval, verification, and entitlement state is stored and which endpoints write it. Attempt direct writes through generic update and bulk endpoints. Then perform the dependent action and confirm that it succeeded without the legitimate transition. Target phases: Critical-state inventory; Write-path discovery; State rewrite; Dependent-action confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, Two accounts, API schema review, Database checks.

metadata.title: CWE-642 Testing Methodology: State Write-Path Discovery

text: Testing playbook: Build a mutation matrix for each protected path: case, encoding, trailing slash, dot segments, and path parameters. Compare the authorization decision with the resolved handler. Use response differences and actual privileged effects to confirm routing. Target phases: Protected path inventory; Canonicalization mutation matrix; Handler resolution analysis; Privileged-action confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, ffuf, Path mutation wordlists, Router fingerprinting.

metadata.title: CWE-647 Testing Methodology: Path Canonicalization Mutation Matrix

text: Testing playbook: Inventory buckets, shares, and queues from application behavior and public naming. Test with no credentials and with a second tenant's credentials. Inspect share links for token scope and expiry. Verify with actual object reads and writes in a controlled scope. Target phases: Resource inventory; Unauthenticated and cross-tenant access; Share-link scope review; Read-write confirmation. Tools: Cloud storage scanners, Burp Suite, curl, Tenant test accounts.

metadata.title: CWE-732 Testing Methodology: Cross-Principal Resource Access

text: Testing playbook: Scan mobile packages, container images, JavaScript bundles, and public repositories for key patterns. Classify each candidate by service and scope. Validate against a sandbox or the real partner API only within authorized limits, and confirm the business action the credential permits. Target phases: Artifact collection; Credential scanning and classification; Direct API validation; Business-action confirmation. Tools: trufflehog, apktool, strings, Postman.

metadata.title: CWE-798 Testing Methodology: Artifact Credential Extraction and Validation

text: Testing playbook: Run the application with two accounts of different roles and replay every captured request across them. Use an authorization-aware proxy mode to flag responses that do not change with role. Pay special attention to bulk, export, and GraphQL operations, which frequently bypass per-object checks. Target phases: Role and endpoint matrix; Cross-role request replay; Nested and bulk path testing; Object-scope confirmation. Tools: Autorize, Burp Suite, Two test accounts, GraphQL introspection.

metadata.title: CWE-862 Testing Methodology: Cross-Role Replay and Object-Scope Testing

text: Testing playbook: For each endpoint, identify the object the check reads and the object the action modifies, then diverge them with nested identifiers and stale memberships. Test invitations and sharing flows for grant-authority boundaries. Remove a member and confirm their access ends immediately. Target phases: Check-to-object mapping; Divergent-object testing; Stale-relationship exploitation; Grant-authority boundary. Tools: Burp Suite, Two accounts, Role matrix, Invitation flows.

metadata.title: CWE-863 Testing Methodology: Check-to-Object Divergence

text: Testing playbook: Record Set-Cookie headers for all authentication states and compare attributes across environments. Read cookies with document.cookie in the target origin. Replay the captured value in a clean browser profile to confirm it authenticates independently of the client. Target phases: Set-Cookie capture; Attribute review; Script readability test; Session replay confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, Browser devtools, Cookie editor, Clean browser profile.

metadata.title: CWE-1004 Testing Methodology: Cookie Attribute and Readability Testing

text: Testing playbook: Inspect response headers and frame the target from a test origin. Attempt nested frames and same-site framing through redirects. If the page frames, test whether the action control is reachable and whether a decoy click performs it, then confirm the business effect in the victim account. Target phases: Frame-header review; Cross-origin framing test; Overlay clickability; Victim-action confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, Browser devtools, Clickjacking PoC page, Two accounts.

metadata.title: CWE-1021 Testing Methodology: Frameability and Overlay Testing

text: Testing playbook: Collect tokens from the smallest and most restricted flows, decode their fields, and attempt to reuse them on higher-value actions. Test amount changes, recipient changes, and replay. Bind confirmation to a settlement or order record. Target phases: Token collection; Scope decoding; Reuse and re-scope attempts; Business-outcome confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, JWT decoder, Replay harness, Payment sandbox.

metadata.title: CWE-1270 Testing Methodology: Token Scope and Reuse Testing

text: Testing playbook: Map position semantics by submitting boundary values and observing which element responds. Test past the end, before the start, and between two records. Compare the response with the persisted target, and verify cross-account effects with a second account. Target phases: Position parameter inventory; Range and alignment mutation; Selected-record attribution; Cross-account effect confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, Two accounts, Python requests, Database checks.

metadata.title: CWE-1285 Testing Methodology: Position Boundary and Attribution

text: Testing playbook: Fuzz each parsed field with trailing garbage, alternate separators, unicode digits, and truncated forms. Compare the validated value with the persisted value and the value used in downstream calculations. Use a differential harness across services where possible. Target phases: Parsed-field inventory; Malformed-string fuzzing; Cross-service parse comparison; Reconciliation impact. Tools: Burp Suite, Python parsers, Locale test corpus, Ledger comparison.

metadata.title: CWE-1286 Testing Methodology: Malformed-String Parse Differentials

text: Testing playbook: Test merge endpoints with __proto__, constructor, and prototype keys, then probe unrelated requests for changed defaults. Use canary properties to detect pollution and confirm that a security-relevant default was altered, not merely that a property exists. Target phases: Merge endpoint inventory; Prototype key injection; Canary property detection; Security-default impact confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, Browser devtools, Custom payloads, Node inspector.

metadata.title: CWE-1321 Testing Methodology: Prototype Key Injection and Canary Detection

text: Testing playbook: Map factors by privilege level and evaluate entropy, expiry, replay, and recovery. Test the recovery path as an alternative authentication channel. Confirm impact only by reaching a function the factor is supposed to protect, using test accounts. Target phases: Factor and privilege mapping; Entropy and replay assessment; Recovery-path testing; Privileged-action confirmation. Tools: Burp Suite, OSINT sources, SMS test numbers, Rate-limit harness.

metadata.title: CWE-1390 Testing Methodology: Factor Entropy and Recovery-Path Testing

text: Testing playbook: walk the order flow with a proxy and capture every request and response. Submit wrong, empty, and expired codes and inspect the full error body for the expected value or session identifier. Replay disclosed values, then substitute the phone number, address, and customer identifier in the final request and compare the persisted order with the verified session. Test code reuse across orders and sessions. Tools: Burp Suite Repeater, OWASP ZAP, Python requests. Target phases: workflow capture, error-body mining, code replay, and field-substitution confirmation.

metadata.title: Testing Order OTP Enforcement Against Error Echoes and Phone Substitution

text: Testing playbook: add items, capture the checkout request and URL, and decode every quantity-bearing parameter. Edit quantities to the limit, limit+1, large values, zero, negative, and fractional; also duplicate the item pair and add unknown item identifiers. Replay through payment initiation and a test transaction. Compare the persisted order lines with the catalog limits. Tools: Burp Suite Repeater, browser devtools, Python requests. Target phases: cart parameter mapping, quantity mutation, payment-boundary validation, and persisted order review.

metadata.title: Testing Purchase Limits Through Direct Cart and Checkout URLs
metadata.report_title: [spectacles.com] Bypassing quantity limit in orders

text: Testing playbook: intercept cart calculation and order placement and mutate quantity to 0.1, 0.6, 0, -1, 1.5, exponent notation, and numeric strings. Keep unit cost and item identifiers constant so the effect is attributable. Compare the cart total, the placement total, and the amount sent to the payment gateway. Place a low-value test order where permitted and reconcile the charge with the delivered item. Tools: Burp Suite, Turbo Intruder, Python decimal model. Target phases: quantity mutation, total reconciliation, and fulfilment-versus-payment comparison.

text: Testing playbook: capture the add-tickets multipart request and decode every field name and value. Mutate the seat descriptor count and price components independently, then in conflicting combinations. Test zero, negative, fractional, and very large counts, and duplicate the field. Compare the order summary, the payment amount, and the issued ticket count. Tools: Burp Suite, multipart editor, Python requests. Target phases: field decoding, count and price mutation, total reconciliation, and ticket issuance check.

text: Testing playbook: capture every OTP issuance request and inspect the full response body, headers, and any GraphQL extensions for the code. Compare the response between registered and unregistered numbers. Test code reuse, expiry, and use across numbers. Then verify whether successful verification authorizes only the intended subscription change or a broader account session. Tools: Burp Suite, browser devtools, Python requests. Target phases: issuance response inspection, secret extraction, code binding tests, and authorization-scope review.

metadata.title: Testing OTP Issuance Responses for Secret Disclosure
metadata.report_title: OTP bypass - Unintended disclosure of OTP to client allows attacker to manage users' subscriptions

text: Testing playbook: use test cards that fail authorization and inspect the plan state after each step. Walk plan selection, seat increase, payment failure, cancellation, and reactivation while recording which features remain available. Compare the entitlement API with the billing ledger. Test downgrade and trial expiry as additional transitions. Tools: Burp Suite, payment-provider test cards, billing dashboard, entitlement API. Target phases: billing-state mapping, failure-path testing, cancellation testing, and entitlement reconciliation.

metadata.title: Testing Subscription State Across Failed Payments and Cancellation
metadata.report_title: [app.lemlist.com] Improper handling of payment lead to bypass payment

text: Testing playbook: capture the acceptance request and replay it sequentially, then in parallel with a single-packet or Turbo Intruder attack. Read the billing or credit balance after each batch rather than trusting the response. Test offer reuse across accounts and after cancellation. Compare the sum of applied credits with the offer value. Tools: Burp Suite Turbo Intruder, billing dashboard, Python requests. Target phases: request capture, sequential replay, concurrent replay, and credit reconciliation.

text: Testing playbook: collect codes from public reports, marketing pages, and emails, then apply each one and record the discount. Repeat on a second order and a second account, and test concurrent application in one cart. Compare the discount with the documented terms and check whether a redemption record appears. Tools: Burp Suite, two accounts, cart automation. Target phases: code collection, application, reuse across orders and accounts, and redemption-record inspection.

text: Testing playbook: map the ad object schema through GET responses and error messages, then attempt to PATCH every server-owned field including review, delivery, billing, and ownership attributes. Compare the response with the persisted object and with actual delivery. Test bulk endpoints and legacy API versions that may share the model. Tools: Burp Suite, API schema review, two advertiser accounts. Target phases: schema mapping, protected-field writes, persistence comparison, and delivery confirmation.

metadata.title: Testing Ad Review State Against Direct API Writes
metadata.report_title: Able to approve admin approval and change effective status without adding payment details.

text: Testing playbook: create a partner workspace with a member and an invited owner, then attempt to register and accept using the invited address without verification. Test case, plus-address, and unicode variants. Test acceptance through an existing account whose email was changed to the invited address. Confirm the effective role and permissions after acceptance. Tools: Burp Suite, two accounts, email test domain. Target phases: invitation flow mapping, unverified registration, acceptance variants, and role confirmation.

metadata.title: Testing Invitation Acceptance Against Unverified Email Registration
metadata.report_title: Shopify Partners Invitation Process Allows Privilege Escalation Without Email Verification

text: Testing playbook: create a workspace on the lowest tier and record the cap. Issue more invitations than the cap allows, then accept them one by one and read the member count. Test acceptance at the exact boundary and in parallel. Check whether removing a member frees a seat for a pending invite. Tools: Burp Suite, multiple email accounts, workspace admin console. Target phases: quota discovery, bulk invitation, boundary acceptance, and member-count verification.

metadata.title: Testing Workspace Seat Limits Against Pending Invitation Inventory
metadata.report_title: User Limit Bypass via Pending Invitations in Workspace System

text: Testing playbook: attempt the gated action with the prerequisite unmet, then replay the underlying request directly, with the flag flipped, and with the flag removed. Test other gated actions that share the same client-side pattern, such as API key creation or payout changes. Confirm the server state after each attempt rather than the UI message. Tools: Burp Suite match-and-replace, Repeater, two accounts. Target phases: gate discovery, request replay, flag manipulation, and server-state confirmation.

metadata.title: Testing Invitation Authorization with a Tampered 2FA Flag
metadata.report_title: 2FA requirement bypass when inviting team members

text: Testing playbook: run an approval workflow with two users, review the file, then modify it before sending the decision. Submit the approval with the correct etag, a stale etag, an empty value, a null, and the field removed. Compare the recorded approved version with the current file version and inspect the audit trail. Tools: Burp Suite, two accounts, file version history. Target phases: workflow setup, version modification, etag omission, and audit comparison.

text: Testing playbook: review the gateway add-on source when available and compare it with a correct sibling implementation. Exercise the return path without a gateway call, then replay the notification with an invalid MAC, an empty MAC, a modified body, and a substituted order token. Compare the order status and published ticket with the actual payment record. Tools: Burp Suite, WordPress test instance, gateway sandbox. Target phases: source review, return-path testing, MAC bypass, and token substitution.

text: Testing playbook: log in to a 2FA-enabled test account and record every cookie issued at the password stage. Delete cookies one at a time and refresh, then replay authenticated requests with each subset. Test empty values, expired refresh cookies, and a second browser profile. Confirm access by calling a privileged endpoint, not by page rendering. Tools: Burp Suite, browser devtools, two browser profiles. Target phases: cookie inventory, deletion matrix, request replay, and privileged-endpoint confirmation.

Repeat through the bulk endpoint and read the billing ledger after each batch. Reconcile total awards with total fees. Tools: Burp Suite, billing export, Python decimal model. Target phases: formula derivation, boundary awards, bulk repetition, and ledger reconciliation.
